subject: 1093年大理国官署衙门（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated 2:1 dimetric city-map building sprite for a historical wuxia game, Dali kingdom in 1093. This is a map sprite NOT an illustration scene. Use supplied image only as matching material and 45-degree MAP CAMERA reference. Orthographic yaw 45 degrees, camera elevation 30 degrees. The two horizontal ground axes on the screen MUST slope +0.5 and -0.5 exactly (one pixel rise per two pixels run). South entrance faces LOWER LEFT. Vertical posts stay vertical. Thin rectangular ground footprint with visible front/left/right corners, no thick plinth. Centered whole sprite with at least10% empty transparent padding on all sides. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, absolutely NO mountains, sky, horizon, trees outside the footprint, gradient backdrop, ambient halo or ground outside rectangle. Realistic weathered gray tiles, dark timber, pale earth plaster and dull stone matching reference material, restrained Song-period silhouette. Light from screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow toward LOWER RIGHT. NO WRITING AT ALL, no banners/boards with characters, no people, no modern objects, no logos, no border, no watermark, no tourism-era decoration. A dignified modest Dali government compound: single-story rear timber hall with broad gray tiled roof, open beaten-earth forecourt, low side service wings, restrained earth-red posts and plain cream walls, south entrance pavilion integrated in low perimeter wall. No text or official plaques, no flag. Footprint 14m east-west by11m north-south.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚底座、旅游古城风格、裁切、透视汇聚
